figures.caption: Fig. 3. Qualitative visualization of different architectures. From left to right: (a) Ground Truth, (b) TransUNet [1], (c) nnU-Net [9], (d) UNETR [7], (e) Swin-UNETR [6], (f) UMamba [10], (g) Ours. Compared with baselines, MAGEFormer yields more anatomically consistent and physically plausible predictions, with less multi-label fragmentation and fewer intra-organ voids that are anatomically implausible.

Fig. 2. Ablation and robustness analysis. (a) Performance stratified by natural anisotropy ratio, showing increasing advantage of MAGEFormer over the baseline as anisotropy grows. (b) Controlled synthetic z-degradation experiment demonstrating the robustness gap widens with increasing downsampling factor. (c) Inference speed vs. accuracy trade-off of Geometric View Voting (GVV), achieving comparable accuracy to standard TTA with 4× speedup.
